reasoning_content:
Signup succeeded (userId e9a80ba8...). But app-sign-in returned 201 with `{}` — empty body. Token probably in cookies (Set-Cookie) or headers. Let me check response headers/cookies.

Let me redo signin capturing Set-Cookie.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,http.cookiejar
EMAIL="woybangsatkauuu+claru@gmail.com"; PW="Claru!2026xyz"
cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
h={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Origin":"https://app.claru.ai","Referer":"https://app.claru.ai/login"}
r=urllib.request.Request("https://app.claru.ai/api/v1/auth/app-sign-in",data=json.dumps({"email":EMAIL,"password":PW}).encode(),headers=h)
with op.open(r,timeout=60) as x:
    print("status:",x.status)
    print("body:",x.read().decode()[:300])
    for k,v in x.headers.items():
        if k.lower() in ("set-cookie","authorization","x-access-token"): print(f"  {k}: {v[:120]}")
print("cookies:",[(c.name,c.value[:30]) for c in cj])
PY
